content.snl: %A GUI syntax-tree editor (Inductive). It lets users edit a SnlSyntaxTree structurally rather than editing plain-text SNL source. CreateEntryApp currently uses it as an alternative UI for SNL input.%
content.markdown: A GUI syntax-tree editor (Inductive). It lets users edit a `SnlSyntaxTree` structurally rather than editing plain-text SNL source. `CreateEntryApp` currently uses it as an alternative UI for SNL input.
